context_title:
Build a complete, production-ready, single-file web application delivered as one `index.html` file. The entire presentation layer, all CSS styling, all HTML markup, and all JavaScript business logic must reside within this single file. No external files other than a CDN-loaded syntax-highlighting library and a separately referenced `/static/manifest.json` and icon assets are permitted. The application is a mobile-first AI chat interface with streaming responses, biometric authentication, rich attachment support, and full conversation history management.

---

## 1. Document Head & PWA Configuration

The `<head>` must contain:

- `charset="UTF-8"`
- `viewport` meta with `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, interactive-widget=resizes-content`
- `mobile-web-app-capable` and `apple-mobile-web-app-capable` set to `yes`
- `apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style` set to `black-translucent`
- `apple-mobile-web-app-title` and `application-name` set to `Chat`
- `theme-color` meta: `#0a0a0e` for dark scheme, `#f5f5f7` for light scheme, using `media` attributes
- `format-detection` set to `telephone=no`
- `<title>Chat</title>`
- `<link rel="manifest" href="/static/manifest.json">`
- Apple touch icons at `/static/icon-180.png` (default), `/static/icon-152.png` (152×152), `/static/icon-167.png` (167×167), `/static/icon-180.png` (180×180)
- Standard icon at `/static/icon-192.png` (192×192)
- An inline SVG data-URI fallback icon: a dark rounded rectangle with a white speech-bubble path
- highlight.js CSS theme from CDN: ``
- highlight.js script from CDN: ``

Immediately before `</head>`, include an inline `<script>` that detects standalone PWA mode (`window.navigator.standalone === true` or `display-mode: standalone` via `matchMedia`) and adds the class `standalone` to `<html>` if true.

---

## 2. CSS Design System

All CSS lives in a single `<style>` block in the head.

### 2.1 CSS Custom Properties (`:root`)

Define the following tokens for dark mode (default):

```
--sat: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)
--sar: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)
--sab: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)
--sal: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)
--blue: #0071e3
--blue-l: #147CE5
--surface: rgba(16,16,18,0.78)
--surface-hi: rgba(255,255,255,0.055)
--border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
--border-s: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)
--fg: #f5f5f7
--fg2: rgba(245,245,247,0.5)
--fg3: rgba(245,245,247,0.25)
--acc / --accent: #0071e3
--glass: rgba(20,20,24,0.72)
--bg: rgba(10,10,14,0.97)
--hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
--user-bg: #0071e3
--ai-bg: rgba(28,28,32,0.95)
--ai-fg: #f5f5f7
--rc-bg: rgba(26,26,30,0.85)
--input-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
--input-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
--sep: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
--liquid-glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.085)
--liquid-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.28)
--liquid-shadow: 0 8px 32px -4px rgba(0,113,227,0.28)
--glow: rgba(0,113,227,0.22)
```

Override for `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)`:

```
--surface: rgba(248,248,250,0.82)
--surface-hi: rgba(255,255,255,0.9)
--border: rgba(0,0,0,0.07)
--border-s: rgba(0,0,0,0.04)
--fg: #1d1d1f
--fg2: rgba(29,29,31,0.5)
--fg3: rgba(29,29,31,0.26)
--bg: rgba(245,245,247,0.97)
--hover: rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
--ai-bg: rgba(242,242,247,0.96)
--ai-fg: #1d1d1f
--rc-bg: rgba(238,238,244,0.9)
--input-bg: rgba(0,0,0,0.05)
--input-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.07)
--sep: rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
--liquid-glass: rgba(245,245,247,0.88)
--liquid-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.14)
--liquid-shadow: 0 8px 32px -4px rgba(0,113,227,0.16)
--glow: rgba(0,113,227,0.18)
```

### 2.2 Global Reset & Typography

- Universal `box-sizing: border-box`, `margin: 0`, `padding: 0`, `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent`
- `html, body`: `-webkit-user-select: none`, `user-select: none`, `-webkit-touch-callout: none`, `height: 100%`, `width: 100%`, `overflow: hidden`, font stack `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif`, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`, `text-rendering: optimizeLegibility`, `-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%`, `overscroll-behavior: none`
- `html.standalone body` and `body`: `background: #000`; light mode body: `background: #f5f5f7`
- Re-enable text selection on: `input`, `textarea`, `[contenteditable="true"]`, `.bubble`, `.ai-bubble`, `.bubble *`, `.ai-bubble *`, `pre`, `code`, `.cb`, `.cb *`, `.err-bbl` — set `user-select: text`, `-webkit-touch-callout: default`
- Disable touch callout and user-select on `button`, `[role="button"]`, `.icon-btn`, `a`, `svg`; set `touch-action: manipulation`
- Apply `-webkit-mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(white, black)` via `@supports (border-radius: 18px)` to: `.bubble`, `.ai-bubble`, `.toast`, `.ibox`, `.sb-new`, `.hcard`, `.rc-wrap`, `.srch-bar`, `.err-bbl`, `.rcn-bar`, `.cb`
- `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`: disable all animations and transitions
- `:focus-visible`: `outline: 2px solid var(--blue-l); outline-offset: 2px`

### 2.3 Animated Background Orbs

`#bg`: `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none`

Three `.orb` children with `position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(110px); will-change: transform; animation: drift var(--d, 24s) ease-in-out infinite alternate; contain: strict`:

- `.o1`: 480×480px, `top: -100px; right: -80px`, radial gradient `rgba(0,113,227,.12)` to transparent, `--d: 22s`
- `.o2`: 360×360px, `bottom: 12%; left: -100px`, radial gradient `rgba(70,70,190,.08)` to transparent, `--d: 29s`, `animation-direction: alternate-reverse`
- `.o3`: 280×280px, `bottom: 0; right: 8%`, radial gradient `rgba(0,70,150,.06)` to transparent, `--d: 20s`

`@keyframes drift`: `0%` → `translate(0,0) scale(1)`; `33%` → `translate(16px,-20px) scale(1.03)`; `66%` → `translate(-10px,14px) scale(.97)`; `100%` → `translate(20px,8px) scale(1.02)`

### 2.4 Layout

`#app`: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; min-height: 100dvh; width: 100%; position: relative; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1`

`#sidebar`: `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 310; padding-top: var(--sat); background: var(--surface); backdrop-filter: blur(60px) saturate(200%) brightness(92%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1.18); will-change: transform`

`#sidebar.open`: `transform: translateX(0)`

`#sidebar.dragging`: `transition: none`

`#sidebar[aria-hidden="true"]`: `pointer-events: none`

`#sidebar[aria-hidden="false"]`: `pointer-events: auto`

`#content`: `flex: 1; overflow: hidden; position: relative; z-index: 1; touch-action: pan-y`

`#scroll-area`: `position: absolute; top: var(--sat); right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; overscroll-behavior-y: contain; touch-action: pan-y; scrollbar-width: none; padding: 12px 0 84px; scroll-padding-top: 20px; scroll-padding-bottom: 20px`

`#msg-list`: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0 14px; min-height: 100%`

### 2.5 Sidebar Components

`.sb-hdr`: 52px height, flex row, `padding: 0 12px`, `border-bottom: .5px solid var(--sep)`, `gap: 6px`

`.sb-title`: `flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.3px; color: var(--fg)`

`.sb-close` (used for search toggle button): 28×28px circle, `background: var(--input-bg)`, `color: var(--fg3)`, scale `.88` on active

`#sb-search-bar`: `flex-shrink: 0; overflow: hidden; height: 0; transition: height .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.28,.64,1)`. When `.open`: `height: 54px`. When not `.open`: `visibility: hidden`.

`.sb-si`: search input row inside search bar, `background: var(--input-bg); border-radius: 13px; border: .5px solid var(--input-border); padding: 0 12px; height: 38px; margin: 8px 14px 6px`

`#sb-q`: transparent input, `font-size: 15px; color: var(--fg)`

`#sb-q-cancel`: animated cancel button, `width: 0; opacity: 0` by default; when `#sb-search-bar.open`: `width: 52px; opacity: 1`; `color: var(--blue-l); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500`

`.sb-body`: `flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-width: none; padding: 12px`

`.sb-pull-hint`: centered flex row, `font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg3); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s`. Visible when `#sidebar.pull-hinting`.

`.sb-new` (New Chat button): `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: rgba(0,113,227,.12); border: .5px solid rgba(0,113,227,.2); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--blue-l)`. Active: scale `.97`.

`.sb-sec`: section label, `font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg3); letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 3px 8px`

`.hcard`: `display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: 6px; background: transparent; border: .5px solid transparent; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1), background .14s, border-color .14s; user-select: none`

`.hcard:hover`: `background: var(--input-bg); border-color: var(--border-s)`

`.hcard:active`: `transform: scale(.97); background: var(--input-bg)`

`.hcard.active`: `background: rgba(0,113,227,.1); border-color: rgba(0,113,227,.18)`. Active title color: `var(--blue-l)`.

`.hcard.long-pressing`: `background: var(--input-bg); border-color: var(--border-s); transform: scale(.98)`

`.hcard-body`: `flex: 1; min-width: 0`

`.hcard-pre`: `font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; letter-spacing: -.15px`

`.hcard-pre mark`: `background: rgba(0,113,227,.22); color: var(--blue-l); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 1px`

`.hcard-pre[contenteditable="true"]`: `outline: none; background: rgba(0,113,227,.1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 5px; margin: -2px -5px; user-select: text`

`.hcard-meta`: `font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg3); margin-top: 2px`

`.hcard-del`: 24×24px, `border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg3); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .13s, transform .2s, background .12s, color .12s`. On hover of parent `.hcard`: `opacity: 1`. On active: `background: rgba(255,59,48,.15); color: rgba(255,59,48,.8); transform: scale(.85)`. On touch devices (`@media (pointer: coarse)`): always `opacity: 1`.

`.hcard-pin`: `display: none; width: 11px; height: 11px`. Visible when `.hcard.pinned`.

`.h-empty`: centered column, `padding: 48px 16px; text-align: center; gap: 9px`

`.sb-bottom`: `margin-top: auto`

### 2.6 Action Sheet (`#action-sheet`)

`position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .25s ease; user-select: none`

When `aria-hidden="false"`: `pointer-events: auto; opacity: 1`

`.as-backdrop`: `position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(2px)`

`.as-container`: `position: relative; padding: 0 8px calc(8px + var(--sab)) 8px; transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px`

When `aria-hidden="false"` `.as-container`: `transform: translateY(0)`

`.as-group`: `background: rgba(28,28,30,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column`. Light mode: `background: rgba(242,242,242,0.94)`.

`.as-title-block`: `padding: 16px 16px 14px; text-align: center; border-bottom: .5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px`

`.as-title`: `font-size: 13px; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.85); font-weight: 600`

`.as-message`: `font-size: 13px; color: rgba(235,235,245,0.55); font-weight: 400`

`.as-option`: `background: transparent; border: none; color: #0a84ff; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; padding: 17px 16px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: .5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); display: block; width: 100%`

`.as-option.destructive`: `color: #ff453a`

`.as-option.destructive.confirm`: `font-weight: 600`

`.as-cancel`: `background: rgba(44,44,46,0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); border: none; border-radius: 14px; color: #0a84ff; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; padding: 17px 16px; cursor: pointer`. Light mode: `background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96)`.

### 2.7 Message Feed Components

`.msg-group`: `display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 14px; animation: bubbleSpring 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both`

`.msg-group.u`: `align-items: flex-end`

`.msg-group.a`: `align-items: flex-start`

`@keyframes bubbleSpring`: from `translateY(14px) scale(0.93) opacity:0` to `none opacity:1`

`.bubble` (user): `max-width: min(76vw,344px); padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.18px; word-break: break-word; border-radius: 18px; position: relative`

`.u .bubble`: `background: var(--user-bg); color: #fff; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0,113,227,.25), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,113,227,.12); animation: bubbleIn .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.64,1)`

`.u .bubble::after`: tail triangle using `clip-path: polygon(0 0,100% 0,0 100%)` at `bottom: 0; right: -6px; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: var(--user-bg); transform: rotate(45deg); z-index: -1`

`@keyframes bubbleIn`: from `opacity:0 translateY(12px) scale(.93)` to `opacity:1 none`

`@keyframes aiBubbleIn`: from `opacity:0 translateX(-8px) scale(.97)` to `opacity:1 none`

`.ai-bubble`: `max-width: min(88vw,440px); padding: 12px 15px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: -.15px; word-break: break-word; border-radius: 18px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; background: var(--ai-bg); color: var(--ai-fg); backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(160%); border: .5px solid var(--border); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.16); animation: aiBubbleIn .36s cubic-bezier(.34,1.15,.64,1); position: relative`

`.ai-bubble::after`: left tail triangle using `clip-path: polygon(100% 0,0 0,100% 100%)` at `bottom: 0; left: -6px; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: var(--ai-bg); transform: rotate(-45deg); z-index: -1`

`.img-in-msg`: `border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; max-width: 220px; max-height: 185px; object-fit: cover; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2)`

`.t-row`: action row below message group, `display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-top: 4px; padding: 0 2px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .16s`. Visible on `.msg-group:hover` or `:focus-within`. `pointer-events: none` by default; `pointer-events: auto` on hover/focus.

`.tact`: small action button, `border-radius: 7px; padding: 3px 9px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--fg3); background: var(--input-bg); cursor: pointer`

`.btime`: `font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg3); margin-top: 4px; padding: 0 3px`

### 2.8 Markdown Rendered Content (`.md`)

Inside `.ai-bubble`, the `md()` function outputs HTML wrapped in a `<div class="md">`. Style:

- `h1`: `font-size: 17.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.4px; margin: 9px 0 5px`
- `h2`: `font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.3px; margin: 8px 0 4px`
- `h3`: `font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin: 7px 0 3px`
- `strong`: `font-weight: 600`
- `em`: `font-style: italic; opacity: .85`
- `a`: `color: var(--blue-l); text-decoration: none`. Hover: underline.
- `ul`: `padding: 3px 0 3px 12px; margin: 3px 0; list-style: none`. `li`: `position: relative; padding: 1px 0 1px 12px`. `li::before`: `content: '·'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--fg3); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4`
- `ol`: `padding: 3px 0 3px 18px; margin: 3px 0`. `li`: `padding: 1px 0`
- `p`: `margin: 4px 0`
- `hr`: `border: none; border-top: .5px solid var(--sep); margin: 8px 0`
- `.ic` (inline code): `display: inline; background: rgba(255,255,255,.09); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: .05px`. Light mode: `background: rgba(0,0,0,.07)`.
- `table`: `width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 8px 0; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; border: .5px solid var(--border)`
- `thead`: `background: var(--input-bg)`
- `th`: `padding: 7px 11px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg2); letter-spacing: .3px; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: .5px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap`
- `td`: `padding: 7px 11px; border-bottom: .5px solid var(--sep); vertical-align: top`
- `tr:last-child td`: `border-bottom: none`
- `tbody tr:nth-child(even) td`: `background: rgba(255,255,255,.025)`. Light: `rgba(0,0,0,.025)`.

### 2.9 Code Block (`.cb`)

`.cb`: `border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; margin: 7px 0; box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.32)`

`.cb-hdr`: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 7px 12px; background: #181820; border-bottom: .5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)`

`.cb-lang`: `font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,.32); letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace`

`.cb-copy`: `border: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 9px; font-size: 10.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); cursor: pointer`

`.cb pre code`: `font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; padding: 10px 13px; display: block; overflow-x: auto; background: #14141a`

### 2.10 Typing Indicator

`.typing`: `display: flex; gap: 4.5px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 18px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; background: var(--ai-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(160%); border: .5px solid var(--border); max-width: 58px; animation: bubbleIn .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.64,1)`

`.td` (dot): `width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg3); animation: td 1.1s cubic-bezier(.36,.11,.89,.32) infinite`. Delays: `.18s` for 2nd, `.36s` for 3rd.

`@keyframes td`: `0%,100%` → `translateY(0) scale(1) opacity:.25`; `25%` → `translateY(-5px) scale(1.15) opacity:.9`; `50%` → `translateY(0) scale(.95) opacity:.4`

### 2.11 Error Bubble

`.err-bbl`: `max-width: min(88vw,440px); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,59,48,.1); border: .5px solid rgba(255,59,48,.18); font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,75,65,.82); line-height: 1.45`

### 2.12 Reasoning Container (`.rc-wrap`)

`.rc-wrap`: `max-width: min(88vw,440px); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 6px; border: .5px solid var(--border-s); background: var(--rc-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%)`

`.rc-head`: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; gap: 8px`

`.rc-label`: `font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .1px; color: var(--fg3)`

`.rc-status`: `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px`

`.rc-dot`: `width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg3); animation: pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite`

`.rc-dot.done`: `animation: none; background: rgba(52,199,89,.55)`

`@keyframes pulse`: `0%,100%` → `opacity:.25`; `50%` → `opacity:.85`

`.rc-dur`: `font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--fg3)`

`.rc-chv`: `font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg3); transition: transform .22s`. When `.open`: `transform: rotate(180deg)`.

`.rc-body`: `overflow: hidden; max-height: 0; transition: max-height .36s cubic-bezier(.32,1.08,.5,1)`. When `.open`: `max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: none`.

`.rc-text`: `font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--fg3); padding: 0 13px 11px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-style: italic`

`.rc-step`: `font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--fg3); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: .7; margin-top: 1px; font-style: italic; max-width: 200px`

`.rc-tools`: `padding: 0 10px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px`. Empty: `display: none`.

### 2.13 Search Status Bar (`.srch-bar`)

`.srch-wrap`: `max-width: min(88vw,440px); margin-bottom: 6px`

`.srch-bar`: `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(0,113,227,.08); border: .5px solid rgba(0,113,227,.18); border-radius: 12px`

`.srch-bar.done`: `background: rgba(52,199,89,.06); border-color: rgba(52,199,89,.18)`

`.srch-ico`: `width: 13px; height: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; animation: spin 1s linear infinite`. Done: `animation: none`.

`@keyframes spin`: `to { transform: rotate(360deg) }`

`.srch-q`: `font-size: 12px; color: var(--blue-l); font-weight: 500; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis`. Done: `color: rgba(52,199,89,.8)`.

`.srch-count`: `font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--fg3); flex-shrink: 0`

`.src-chips`: `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; margin-top: 5px`

`.src-chip`: `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 9px; background: var(--input-bg); border: .5px solid var(--border-s); border-radius: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg2); max-width: 150px`. Hover: `background: var(--surface-hi); color: var(--fg)`. Active: `scale(.95)`.

`.src-chip img`: `width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; object-fit: cover`
